title: 軌道電路列車占用偵測~Track-circuit train-occupancy detection
focus: 軌道電路回路分流與可信占用判讀~Track-circuit paths shunting and trustworthy occupancy interpretation
summary: 本課聚焦軌道電路回路分流與可信占用判讀。從軌道回路電阻帳建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把牽引干擾訊雜比與斷線與供電異常辨識連成可驗證的介面，最後以誤占用維修履歷整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies track-circuit paths shunting and trustworthy occupancy interpretation. Start with resistance accounting for the track circuit to define physical or information boundaries, connect signal quality under traction interference with distinguishing disconnection and supply faults as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through maintenance history of false occupancy. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對軌道電路回路分流與可信占用判讀而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用輪對分流與漏電及乾濕與故障情境矩陣連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For track-circuit paths shunting and trustworthy occupancy interpretation, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through wheelset shunts and leakage and dry wet and fault test matrix. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究軌道回路電阻帳。原創假想教學輸入：激勵電壓 V=12 V；等效電阻 R=8 ohm。公式 y=V/R，代入得 y=1.5 A。邊界：純電阻穩態概念模型，未含交流電抗或任何現場占用判定門檻。敏感度只改 R=8 至 8.8 ohm，輸出變為 1.36364 A；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究輪對分流與漏電：原創假想教學輸入：支路一電阻 R1=10 ohm；支路二電阻 R2=40 ohm。公式 y=R1*R2/(R1+R2)，代入得 y=8 ohm。邊界：兩個線性電阻的靜態教具，未模擬頻率選擇接收器。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元用隔離低壓回路比較送端、鋼軌和接收端電壓，先畫完整回流路徑再解釋電流變化。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate resistance accounting for the track circuit. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: excitation voltage V=12 V; equivalent resistance R=8 ohm. Formula y=V/R gives y=1.5 A. Boundary: Steady resistive teaching model; AC reactance and real occupancy thresholds are not included. For sensitivity, change only R=8 to 8.8 ohm; the output becomes 1.36364 A. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate wheelset shunts and leakage: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: branch one resistance R1=10 ohm; branch two resistance R2=40 ohm. Formula y=R1*R2/(R1+R2) gives y=8 ohm. Boundary: Static teaching circuit with two linear resistors; frequency-selective receivers are not represented. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Use an isolated low-voltage circuit to compare feed, rail and receiver voltages, drawing the complete return path before interpreting current changes. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 軌道回路電阻帳~Resistance accounting for the track circuit
units.title: 軌道回路電阻帳~Resistance accounting for the track circuit
units.mechanism: 本單元用隔離低壓回路比較送端、鋼軌和接收端電壓，先畫完整回流路徑再解釋電流變化。電壓與電流的關係取決於完整回路阻抗，不能只看單一導體。簡化電阻模型能用來辨認分流、接觸與漏電的量級，但交流軌道電路還涉及頻率、相位與耦合；量到電壓存在並不等於接收端已可靠判定。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：純電阻穩態概念模型，未含交流電抗或任何現場占用判定門檻。~Use an isolated low-voltage circuit to compare feed, rail and receiver voltages, drawing the complete return path before interpreting current changes. Voltage-current behaviour depends on the entire circuit rather than one conductor. A resistance model helps reason about shunts, contacts and leakage, while AC track circuits also depend on frequency, phase and coupling. Voltage presence alone does not establish a valid receiver decision. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Steady resistive teaching model; AC reactance and real occupancy thresholds are not included.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：激勵電壓 V=12 V；等效電阻 R=8 ohm。公式 y=V/R，代入得 y=1.5 A。邊界：純電阻穩態概念模型，未含交流電抗或任何現場占用判定門檻。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: excitation voltage V=12 V; equivalent resistance R=8 ohm. Formula y=V/R gives y=1.5 A. Boundary: Steady resistive teaching model; AC reactance and real occupancy thresholds are not included.
units.verify: 在完全隔離的低壓教具量測源端與負載端電壓電流，逐一改變接觸或漏電支路。以「軌道回路電阻帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~On an isolated low-voltage teaching rig, measure source and load voltage/current while changing contact or leakage branches one at a time. For resistance accounting for the track circuit, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 接觸阻抗上升與供電下降都會降低電流，可用兩端電壓分布辨認，不能直接在營運軌道上試驗。回到「軌道回路電阻帳」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Contact resistance and supply drop both reduce current; terminal voltage distribution distinguishes them. Such experiments do not belong on an operating track. Trace the input chain for resistance accounting for the track circuit. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 只量到供電端有電壓就可確認接收端一定正常~Voltage at the supply terminal proves the receiver is operating correctly.
units.practice: 只把等效電阻 R 從 8 改成 8.8 ohm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.5 變為 1.36364 A。先說明「軌道回路電阻帳」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only equivalent resistance R from 8 to 8.8 ohm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1.5 to 1.36364 A. Explain the causal direction for resistance accounting for the track circuit, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 輪對分流與漏電~Wheelset shunts and leakage
units.title: 輪對分流與漏電~Wheelset shunts and leakage
units.mechanism: 本單元把輪對支路與道床漏電支路分開，研究不同路徑如何產生相似的接收訊號下降。並聯支路分配電流並降低總等效電阻。新增漏電路徑可能改變接收訊號而不改變供電電壓，乾濕環境的差異因此不能被單純視為量測雜訊；是否代表安全占用仍須由完整的故障安全設計決定。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩個線性電阻的靜態教具，未模擬頻率選擇接收器。~Separate the wheelset path from ballast leakage and examine how different paths can produce similar reductions in the received signal. Parallel paths divide current and reduce equivalent resistance. A leakage path can alter the received signal without changing supply voltage, so differences between dry and wet conditions are not merely measurement noise. Whether a condition produces a safe occupied indication depends on the complete fail-safe design. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Static teaching circuit with two linear resistors; frequency-selective receivers are not represented.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：支路一電阻 R1=10 ohm；支路二電阻 R2=40 ohm。公式 y=R1*R2/(R1+R2)，代入得 y=8 ohm。邊界：兩個線性電阻的靜態教具，未模擬頻率選擇接收器。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: branch one resistance R1=10 ohm; branch two resistance R2=40 ohm. Formula y=R1*R2/(R1+R2) gives y=8 ohm. Boundary: Static teaching circuit with two linear resistors; frequency-selective receivers are not represented.
units.verify: 保持激勵相同而分別量支路電流，確認總電流守恆，再比對不同絕緣情境。以「輪對分流與漏電」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Keep excitation fixed, measure branch currents separately, verify current conservation, and compare insulation scenarios. For wheelset shunts and leakage, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 將漏電誤判為輪對分流會混淆故障來源；量測儀輸入電阻太低也可能自己形成額外分流。回到「輪對分流與漏電」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Confusing leakage with a wheelset shunt misidentifies the fault; an instrument with low input resistance can itself create a parallel path. Trace the input chain for wheelset shunts and leakage. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 並聯多一條漏電路徑不會改變整個電路的電流~Adding a parallel leakage path cannot change the total circuit current.
units.practice: 只把支路二電阻 R2 從 40 改成 44 ohm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 8 變為 8.14815 ohm。先說明「輪對分流與漏電」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only branch two resistance R2 from 40 to 44 ohm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 8 to 8.14815 ohm. Explain the causal direction for wheelset shunts and leakage, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 輸入濾波與延時~Input filtering and delay
units.title: 輸入濾波與延時~Input filtering and delay
units.mechanism: 本單元以階躍試驗觀察接收端濾波的延遲代價，將短脈衝抑制與真正狀態改變分開。電阻電容時間常數表示一階響應速度，濾除短脈衝也會延後真正的狀態改變。增強濾波與提高反應速度常互相衝突；訊號判定應結合雜訊頻譜與允許延遲，不可只追求顯示平穩。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：線性一階小訊號模型，時間常數不是確定的安全動作延時。~Use a step test to observe the latency cost of receiver filtering, distinguishing suppression of brief pulses from a genuine state change. An RC time constant characterizes first-order response. Suppressing brief pulses also delays genuine state changes, creating a tradeoff between filtering and response. Signal interpretation must consider noise spectra and allowable delay rather than aiming only for a smooth display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear first-order small-signal model; the time constant is not a prescribed safety-action delay.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：電阻 R=10000 ohm；電容量 C=0.0001 F。公式 y=R*C，代入得 y=1 s。邊界：線性一階小訊號模型，時間常數不是確定的安全動作延時。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: resistance R=10000 ohm; capacitance C=0.0001 F. Formula y=R*C gives y=1 s. Boundary: Linear first-order small-signal model; the time constant is not a prescribed safety-action delay.
units.verify: 用已知階躍輸入量測上升與下降曲線，從曲線擬合時間常數並檢查非對稱。以「輸入濾波與延時」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Apply a known step, measure rise and decay, fit the time constant, and inspect response asymmetry. For input filtering and delay, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 濾波過重會延遲異常呈現，電容量漂移則可能讓同一設定在不同溫度下具有不同反應。回到「輸入濾波與延時」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Over-filtering delays anomaly indication; capacitance drift can change response with temperature despite unchanged settings. Trace the input chain for input filtering and delay. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 濾波越強就能同時得到越快的狀態反應~Stronger filtering always gives a faster state response as well.
units.practice: 只把電容量 C 從 0.0001 改成 0.00011 F（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1 變為 1.1 s。先說明「輸入濾波與延時」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only capacitance C from 0.0001 to 0.00011 F (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1 to 1.1 s. Explain the causal direction for input filtering and delay, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 牽引干擾訊雜比~Signal quality under traction interference
units.title: 牽引干擾訊雜比~Signal quality under traction interference
units.mechanism: 本單元比較固定頻寬內的有效訊號和干擾，不以總電壓變大就判斷占用辨識能力改善。以相同阻抗下的電壓比換算訊雜比時使用二十倍對數。訊號與雜訊必須採一致頻寬與有效值定義；只把量測頻寬縮小可能讓數字改善，卻同時刪掉辨識狀態所需的訊息。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：相同阻抗與相同頻寬的均方根電壓，不適用任意峰值比。~Compare useful signal and interference within a fixed bandwidth rather than assuming that greater total voltage means improved occupancy discrimination. Voltage-ratio signal-to-noise uses twenty times the logarithm when impedances match. Signal and noise must share bandwidth and RMS definitions. Narrowing measurement bandwidth can improve the number while removing information needed to distinguish states. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: RMS voltages with equal impedance and bandwidth; arbitrary peak ratios are not interchangeable.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：訊號有效值 signal=2 V_rms；雜訊有效值 noise=0.1 V_rms。公式 y=20*log10(signal/noise)，代入得 y=26.0206 dB。邊界：相同阻抗與相同頻寬的均方根電壓，不適用任意峰值比。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: signal RMS signal=2 V_rms; noise RMS noise=0.1 V_rms. Formula y=20*log10(signal/noise) gives y=26.0206 dB. Boundary: RMS voltages with equal impedance and bandwidth; arbitrary peak ratios are not interchangeable.
units.verify: 將有訊號與無訊號樣本採同一濾波器處理，保留頻譜與時間波形交叉比對。以「牽引干擾訊雜比」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Process signal-present and signal-absent samples through the same filter, retaining both spectra and time traces. For signal quality under traction interference, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 電磁干擾若落在訊號頻帶內，總有效值可能變大但辨識反而變差；飽和也會破壞比例。回到「牽引干擾訊雜比」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~In-band interference may increase total RMS while worsening identification; saturation also destroys the assumed proportionality. Trace the input chain for signal quality under traction interference. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 總量測電壓越大就能保證訊號品質越好~A larger measured total voltage guarantees better signal quality.
units.practice: 只把雜訊有效值 noise 從 0.1 改成 0.11 V_rms（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 26.0206 變為 25.1927 dB。先說明「牽引干擾訊雜比」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only noise RMS noise from 0.1 to 0.11 V_rms (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 26.0206 to 25.1927 dB. Explain the causal direction for signal quality under traction interference, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.title: 偵測至聯鎖交接~Detection-to-interlocking handoff
units.mechanism: 本單元沿回路量測、接收判定和聯鎖採用追蹤時間，檢查介面等待是否被各自量測漏掉。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Trace timing from circuit measurement through receiver decision to interlocking use, checking for interface waits omitted by separate measurements. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
units.verify: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。以「偵測至聯鎖交接」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load. For detection-to-interlocking handoff, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「偵測至聯鎖交接」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Trace the input chain for detection-to-interlocking handoff. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短~Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
units.practice: 只把網路時間 network 從 0.08 改成 0.088 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.25 變為 0.258 s。先說明「偵測至聯鎖交接」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only network time network from 0.08 to 0.088 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.25 to 0.258 s. Explain the causal direction for detection-to-interlocking handoff, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 占用事件時間校核~Checking occupancy-event timing
units.title: 占用事件時間校核~Checking occupancy-event timing
units.mechanism: 本單元將實際模型輪對通過與接收輸出放在同一時基，分開時鐘偏差及接收反應時間。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Place model-wheelset passage and receiver output on one timebase, separating clock offset from receiver response time. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
units.verify: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「占用事件時間校核」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For checking occupancy-event timing, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「占用事件時間校核」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for checking occupancy-event timing. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致~Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
units.practice: 只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「占用事件時間校核」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only unsynchronized interval duration from 3600 to 3960 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. Explain the causal direction for checking occupancy-event timing, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 斷線與供電異常辨識~Distinguishing disconnection and supply faults
units.title: 斷線與供電異常辨識~Distinguishing disconnection and supply faults
units.mechanism: 本單元把可能造成訊號消失的回路斷線與供電異常列成失效樹，要求可區分原因的觀測。只要任一支路失效就產生頂事件時，需計算聯集而不是把兩機率相乘。獨立假設允許扣掉交集的乘積，若共享電源、環境或軟體則交集另有結構；事件樹和失效樹必須保持同一任務時間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。~Build a fault tree for circuit disconnection and supply problems that can both remove a signal, requiring observations that distinguish the causes. When either branch can trigger the top event, the relevant probability is a union rather than a product. Independence permits the intersection to be written as a product; shared power, environment or software changes that intersection. Event and fault trees must use the same mission duration. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。公式 y=p1+p2-p1*p2，代入得 y=0.002998 1。邊界：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: event one probability p1=0.001 1; event two probability p2=0.002 1. Formula y=p1+p2-p1*p2 gives y=0.002998 1. Boundary: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour.
units.verify: 先畫頂事件邏輯再代機率，明列共享資源並檢查事件時間窗是否一致。以「斷線與供電異常辨識」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Draw top-event logic before inserting probabilities, list shared resources, and check consistent time windows. For distinguishing disconnection and supply faults, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。回到「斷線與供電異常辨識」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Confusing a union with an intersection understates risk; mixing annual and hourly probabilities destroys the intended meaning. Trace the input chain for distinguishing disconnection and supply faults. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘~If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product.
units.practice: 只把事件一機率 p1 從 0.001 改成 0.0011 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.002998 變為 0.0030978 1。先說明「斷線與供電異常辨識」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only event one probability p1 from 0.001 to 0.0011 1 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.002998 to 0.0030978 1. Explain the causal direction for distinguishing disconnection and supply faults, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 接收鏈共同原因~Common causes in receiving chains
units.title: 接收鏈共同原因~Common causes in receiving chains
units.mechanism: 本單元檢查重複接收器是否共用軌道輸入與電源，說明雙設備無法自行消除輸入共同失效。兩支路都失效才失去功能的架構可降低獨立故障貢獻，卻不能消除共同原因。共同電源、相同軟體缺陷或同處淹水會同時影響兩支路；因此增加硬體數量不能取代分離、異質性與失效偵測的證據。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。~Check whether duplicated receivers share the track input and power supply, explaining why duplication cannot remove a common input failure by itself. A function lost only when both branches fail can reduce independent contributions but cannot eliminate common causes. Shared power, identical software defects or flooding at one location can affect both branches. More hardware does not replace evidence for separation, diversity and fault detection. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立支路失效機率 p=0.002 1；共同原因事件機率 common=0.0001 1。公式 y=common+(1-common)*p*p，代入得 y=0.000104 1。邊界：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent branch failure probability p=0.002 1; common-cause event probability common=0.0001 1. Formula y=common+(1-common)*p*p gives y=0.000104 1. Boundary: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied.
units.verify: 把獨立與共同原因兩類試驗分開，在隔離試驗台檢查共享介面失效的影響。以「接收鏈共同原因」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Separate independent and common-cause tests, using an isolated bench to examine failures of shared interfaces. For common causes in receiving chains, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。回到「接收鏈共同原因」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. Trace the input chain for common causes in receiving chains. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障~Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures.
units.practice: 只把共同原因事件機率 common 從 0.0001 改成 0.00011 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.000104 變為 0.000114 1。先說明「接收鏈共同原因」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only common-cause event probability common from 0.0001 to 0.00011 1 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.000104 to 0.000114 1. Explain the causal direction for common causes in receiving chains, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 乾濕與故障情境矩陣~Dry wet and fault test matrix
units.title: 乾濕與故障情境矩陣~Dry wet and fault test matrix
units.mechanism: 本單元以教具建立乾濕漏電、接觸變化與干擾案例，明列哪些狀態仍未取得測試證據。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Build teaching-rig cases for dry/wet leakage, contact changes and interference, explicitly listing states for which test evidence is still absent. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.verify: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「乾濕與故障情境矩陣」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For dry wet and fault test matrix, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「乾濕與故障情境矩陣」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for dry wet and fault test matrix. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險~One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
units.practice: 只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「乾濕與故障情境矩陣」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for dry wet and fault test matrix, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 誤占用維修履歷~Maintenance history of false occupancy
units.title: 誤占用維修履歷~Maintenance history of false occupancy
units.mechanism: 本單元分開保守占用顯示與真正設備失效紀錄，將重複報修合併到同一根因而保留服務影響。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。~Separate conservative occupied indications from equipment-failure records, linking repeated reports to one cause while retaining their service impact. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
units.verify: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「誤占用維修履歷」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For maintenance history of false occupancy, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「誤占用維修履歷」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for maintenance history of false occupancy. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的~High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
units.practice: 只把平均修復時間 mttr 從 4 改成 4.4 h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.998004 變為 0.997805 1。先說明「誤占用維修履歷」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only mean repair time mttr from 4 to 4.4 h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.998004 to 0.997805 1. Explain the causal direction for maintenance history of false occupancy, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

facts: 教學假設：軌道回路電阻帳採 V=12 V；本課公式結果 1.5 A，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for resistance accounting for the track circuit: V=12 V; this model gives 1.5 A, not a field rating.
教學假設：輪對分流與漏電採 R1=10 ohm；本課公式結果 8 ohm，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for wheelset shunts and leakage: R1=10 ohm; this model gives 8 ohm, not a field rating.
教學假設：輸入濾波與延時採 R=10000 ohm；本課公式結果 1 s，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for input filtering and delay: R=10000 ohm; this model gives 1 s, not a field rating.
教學假設：牽引干擾訊雜比採 signal=2 V_rms；本課公式結果 26.0206 dB，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for signal quality under traction interference: signal=2 V_rms; this model gives 26.0206 dB, not a field rating.
教學假設：偵測至聯鎖交接採 sense=0.03 s；本課公式結果 0.25 s，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for detection-to-interlocking handoff: sense=0.03 s; this model gives 0.25 s, not a field rating.
教學假設：占用事件時間校核採 drift=20 ppm；本課公式結果 0.072 s，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for checking occupancy-event timing: drift=20 ppm; this model gives 0.072 s, not a field rating.
